resolved_catalog_changes.client_signal: Hermes Agent and OpenClaw expose broad provider/model fields with uneven completeness across usage scenarios.
resolved_catalog_changes.provider_resolution: Source provenance is retained for audit and conflicts but does not assign a confidence tier or gate otherwise sufficient metadata.
resolved_catalog_changes.catalog_result: Materialized unified provider and model records with generic provenance_refs, field-derived completeness, and usable_for scenarios; operational execution remains separately qualified.

resolved_catalog_changes.client_signal: Both clients distinguished current and legacy DeepSeek V4 identifiers; OpenClaw also exposed divergent vision and price assertions.
resolved_catalog_changes.provider_resolution: Provider documentation identifies DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and V4 Pro 0813 separately and marks legacy Flash identifiers as accepted retired aliases.
resolved_catalog_changes.catalog_result: Two model identities, binding-level alias lifecycle/replacement, and two product-scoped time-window pricing facts.

resolved_catalog_changes.client_signal: Provider-scoped records kept unknown or partial capability, limit, lifecycle, modality, rendering, and endpoint fields even where official family documentation and the user decision allow a determinate conservative outcome.
resolved_catalog_changes.provider_resolution: Every indeterminate field is closed through a reviewed rule table: searched facts stay observed, conservative family/product inferences are recorded per field as basis=inferred with their rule_key and evidence, and explicit unsupported or not-applicable outcomes are used where the field does not apply.
resolved_catalog_changes.catalog_result: 761 model records and 103 provider records are fully determinate; inference rules, field provenance, execution_fit outcomes, and the extended vocabulary are embedded in the catalog and re-verified by closure fixed-point and field validators.

resolved_catalog_changes.client_signal: Both clients listed hy3, hy3-preview, and hy4-preview; Hermes also listed the same TokenHub and Token Plan product split.
resolved_catalog_changes.provider_resolution: Tencent product pages establish hy3, hy3-202608, hy3-preview, hy4-preview, 1024k Hy4 context, and Hy3 preview routing to Hy3 in the plan.
resolved_catalog_changes.catalog_result: Documented upstream IDs and six conditional product bindings; account availability and protocol qualification remain runtime-required.
